description: Ambient meeting talk that must NEVER execute as a board command. Channel A replays each utterance through the wake-word router (mic armed, no gate). Channel B replays it through the deterministic parser as externally activated — the worst case where a push-to-talk gate is open while someone talks to a colleague.
